title: FIBA: Dwight Ramos says happy to see Bennie Boatwright join Gilas
summary: Dwight Ramos is looking forward to playing alongside Bennie Boatwright as Gilas Pilipinas prepares for its crucial campaign in the fifth window of the 2027 FIBA World Cup Asian Qualifiers.
